headline: 31 health groups urge US Congress to pass SOAR Act before 2027
dek: The American Lung Association said a coalition of 31 national health and advocacy organisations has called on Congress to pass the SOAR Act, citing access to oxygen.
body:
The American Lung Association said on X on 10 November 2026 that 31 national health and advocacy organisations had urged Congress to pass the SOAR Act before 2027. The post gave the bill numbers as H.R. 2902/S.1406.

The association wrote that "patients cannot afford to wait any longer". It invited others to join its call on Congress "so everyone can get the oxygen they need", and included a link for further information.

The post did not name the other organisations in the coalition or set out the provisions of the bill. The American Lung Association describes itself on X as working to improve lung health and prevent lung disease.
key_quote: Patients cannot afford to wait any longer.
